name: wechat-miniprogram-live-preview
description: See a real WeChat Mini Program runtime inside VS Code while coding with filesystem-based AI agents.

miniProgramPreview.devtoolsPath.description: Optional path to the WeChat DevTools app or CLI executable.

miniProgramPreview.projectPath.description: Optional Mini Program directory or project.config.json path, relative to the workspace or absolute.

miniProgramPreview.autoRefresh.description: Refresh the preview after Mini Program source files change.

miniProgramPreview.refreshDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds used to coalesce filesystem writes.

miniProgramPreview.automatorPort.description: Local Automator WebSocket port passed to cli auto; separate from the IDE HTTP Service Port.

miniProgramPreview.launchDevTools.description: Allow the Automator launcher to start WeChat DevTools when needed.

miniProgramPreview.autoReconnect.description: Retry a disconnected runtime with bounded backoff.

miniProgramPreview.captureDelay.description: Initial adaptive wait in milliseconds before capturing a screenshot.

miniProgramPreview.maxRefreshRetries.description: Maximum screenshot stability attempts per refresh.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/AutomatorClient.test.js out/test/DevToolsController.test.js out/test/DevToolsLocator.test.js out/test/PreviewSession.test.js out/test/ProjectDetector.test.js out/test/project/ProjectDetector.test.js out/test/refresh/RefreshScheduler.test.js
